Article 3 (Composition of the Committee for Preparing the Establishment of a Common Fund)
① In order to establish a common fund for a single agricultural product, where two or more agricultural organizations jointly establish a common fund in accordance with Article 3(3) of the Act, a Committee for Preparing the Establishment of a Common Fund (hereinafter referred to as "the Committee") must be established.
② The Committee shall be composed of no more than 15 members, and the members shall be appointed by the heads of the agricultural organizations in consultation with each other, and the chairperson shall be elected from among the members.
1. No more than 8 agricultural producers
2. No more than 4 members of the agricultural organization
3. 1 academic, 1 consumer and distribution expert
③ The Committee may make the following decisions with the presence and consent of more than half of the members:
1. The establishment plan for the mandatory agricultural fund (hereinafter referred to as "the mandatory fund") as stipulated in Article 5(1) of the Act, or the establishment plan for the discretionary agricultural fund (hereinafter referred to as "the discretionary fund") as stipulated in Article 24 of the Act.
2. Any other matters necessary for the establishment of the mandatory fund or the discretionary fund.
④ The Committee

The committee established pursuant to Article 14, or the committee established pursuant to Article 26, shall continue to exist until the committee established under Article 14 or the committee established under Article 26 is established.
⑤ In addition to the matters specified in paragraphs (1) through (4), any matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the joint preparation committee shall be determined by the committee chair after being approved by the joint preparation committee.
